source.note: deployed_release is the release directory prefix in host.txt and resolves uniquely here to release_commit, the receiver deployment commit before its review fixes. Its rust-toolchain.toml and Cargo.lock are source configuration: nothing attests that host.txt's binary was built from it.

publication: public-init.json holds the served directory manifest: genesis, coverage from height 3428143 to the 3511128 anchor, geometry and filter sets
limits: a point-in-time inventory, not a qualification run
performance: not applicable: a point-in-time inventory measures no performance
not_retained: the deployed binary's compiler, resolved dependencies, Cargo profile, build command and build host
an attestation tying host.txt's binary SHA-256 to release_commit
the Droplet's CPU model, RAM, storage and running OS and kernel; droplet.json gives only its size slug and creation image
the capture client's environment: its host, tool versions and network location
the upstream Zcash node's version and configuration, and network conditions during the capture
